points.description: Names at least two of the three principles: consensus, industry-wide applicability, voluntary nature (any wording, e.g. 'agreement of all parties', 'used across industries', 'not mandatory/optional').
points.partial_credit: Half mark if only one principle is correct.

points.description: Names all three principles (or the third one in addition to P1): consensus, industry-wide applicability, voluntary nature, in any wording.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if exactly two are correct.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for all three principles, or about three quarters credit if two are clearly right with a close idea for the third; synonyms like 'agreement', 'applicable to all industries', 'voluntary/not compulsory' are fine. Give 1 mark for two correct principles, or 0.5 for one. Give 0 if none match.
